info.title: Mayarin API
info.description: Create fiat-denominated commerce requests, accept supported crypto assets, and settle merchants in stablecoins. Versioned operations live under `/v1`; buyer-facing checkout, invoice, and health routes are intentionally unversioned.

tags.name: Invoices
tags.description: Numbered requests with buyers and due dates.

tags.name: Unversioned
tags.description: Buyer-facing routes that stay at the root forever. A printed QR and a shared link encode them, so a version bump must never move them.

secretKey.description: Server-side `sk_` key. Grants a subset of the merchant's permissions.

publishableOrSecretKey.description: Browser-safe `pk_` key, or a stronger server-side `sk_` key. Identifies the merchant for catalog read and cart checkout; carries no permissions.

amount.description: Exact minor units. Calculate with this value.

asset.description: ISO asset code, e.g. IDR, USD, USDC.

display.description: Localized display text. Never parse this value.

uri.description: EIP-681 payment URI for a QR, or null when none can be built safely.

transaction.description: Ready payEth call for a native payer; null for an ERC-20 payer.

status.description: Derived payment status: DRAFT, ISSUED, PARTIALLY_PAID, PAID, or VOID.

post.description: Creates an immutable fiat-denominated payment request. Reusing an idempotency key with the same body returns the original intent; the same key with different parameters is a 409.

schema.description: Stable unique key for this logical write. Keep it unchanged when retrying.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

post.description: Confirms the intent and hands it to the clearing engine. Safe to retry: confirming an intent that is already clearing returns its current position rather than starting a second one.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

get.description: Accepts a payment intent id (`pi_…`) or clearing transaction id (`clr_…`).

200.description: Payment, clearing state, deposit, and timeline.

get.description: Returns the signed EIP-712 order, the deployed PaymentRouter address and chain, and a fresh executable route for an on-chain-contract payment. A 404 means the contract path is not enabled; a 410 means the quote lock expired — request a new payment.

404.description: Contract path not enabled, or no such payment.

Intentionally unversioned. Server-Sent Events: the first frame carries the current status; later frames are a nudge (`event: payment`) that tells the client to re-read the payment. The stream closes once the payment is terminal.

200.description: SSE stream of payment status nudges.
